scope: Ayurvedic and herbal face packs sold in India and the UK. A small reference set, not a market survey: finding nothing here says nothing about what else is sold.
method: Each product page was fetched once, by hand, on the retrieval date. Ingredient names are copied as the page publishes them. Quantities are recorded only where the page publishes them. Nothing was added from memory; where a page names only some ingredients, the entry says so in ingredient_list_scope.
verification: retrieved_not_reviewed: the text below matches the page on the retrieval date. Nobody has checked the product labels themselves, and the pages can change.
